page.layout: One printed title page, one column of centred lines. Large type at the top, smaller lines in the middle, a short imprint line near the foot.
page.notes: The title page is very faded and partly overlaid by show-through from the reverse, so most lines cannot be read letter by letter. The largest top lines appear to begin with a name in the form "Calvini", but this is not legible enough to copy. The imprint line in capitals near the foot seems to read BASILEAE with a date, which I could not confirm. A circular stamp or seal in green ink sits at the left and is not transcribed. Dark spots and stains are not transcribed.
